meta.coverage: All India, current weekly status (CWS), rural and urban areas, revamped design, from Apr-Jun 2025: LFPR, WPR and UR by gender, sector and age band (15 and above, 15 to 29, all ages).
meta.revisionPolicy: Final on release. Two survey designs, never joined: the original design (agriculture years 2017-18 to 2023-24, calendar years 2022 to 2024, the urban quarterly bulletin to Oct-Dec 2024) and the revamped design from January 2025 (monthly bulletin from Apr 2025, quarterly bulletin with rural areas and states from Apr-Jun 2025, calendar year 2025 on).
